exposure: cleavage stage embryo transfer on day 3
blastocyst stage embryo transfer on day 5
cohort: 167 patients who previously had an IVF treatment and delivered by cesarean section
finding: The study found that while the presence of isthmocele did not appear to increase the risk of Cesarean Scar Pregnancy (CSP), performing embryo transfer on day 3, rather than day 5 at the blastocyst stage, was associated with an increased risk of CSP.
